name: Spaceship 9bebe7ea on the 2-uniform tiling k2-006
description: A period-16 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-006 (touching neighbours), 8 to 11 cells, moving one lattice step every 16 generations (c/16). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S1346 to B3,8,9,10,11,12/S1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-028. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-028 (seen 13 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
